# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

# Figure 4 and Figure S6/S7/S8

R data analysis scripts for re-creating Figure 4 and Figure S6/S7/S8. 

# Software requirements

```{r, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
# Run with R version 4.3.2
library(tidyverse)
library(conflicted)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(foreach)
library(scran)
library(ggnewscale)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(pec)
library(edgeR)
library(clValid)
library(caret)
library(imcRtools)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::count)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)
```

# Figure 4

## 4A

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# ONCOPRINT
snv <- mutation_anno
snv <- snv %>% filter(PID %in% metadata_selected$PID)
snv$mut_level <- snv$variant_consequence_combined
snv <- snv %>% select(PID, Genes, mut_level)
mut_levels_for_matrix <- snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
Genes_list <- Genes_list[!Genes_list %in% c("SF3B1", "STAG2", "ARHGAP35")]

# Main function
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_Genes <- Genes_list[1]
pids <- unique(snv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]
for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
    x <- snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Genes %in% Genes_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", Genes_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Genes) |      
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", Genes_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Genes) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, Genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Genes, value)
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_Genes
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen = setdiff(Genes_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
}

# Clonality anno
subclonal_anno <- mutation_anno %>% select(PID, Genes, clonality) %>% unique() %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = Genes, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), colnames(subclonal_anno))]
mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno

### PLOT 
## Step 1: Define alteration function
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8,"Paired"))(length(unique(snv$mut_level)))
names(col) <- c("missense_variant", "DELETION", "frameshift_variant", 
"inframe_del_ins", "splice_site", "AMPLIFICATION", "protein_altering_variant", "stop_gained_lost_start_lost")
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  missense_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[1], col = NA)),
  DELETION = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[2], col = NA)),
  frameshift_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[3], col = NA)),
  inframe_del_ins = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[4], col = NA)),
  splice_site = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[5], col = NA)),
  AMPLIFICATION = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[6], col = NA)),
  protein_altering_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[7], col = NA)),
  stop_gained_lost_start_lost = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[8], col = NA)),
  multiple = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 8),
  subclonal = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)

## Step 2: Column Annotation
c_anno <- data.frame(PID = colnames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
c_anno$cohort <- mutation_anno$cohort[match(c_anno$PID, mutation_anno$PID)]
c_anno$survival_ecotypes <- metadata_selected$survival_ecotypes[match(c_anno$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
cohort_col <- setNames(brewer.pal(3, "Paired")[1:2],unique(c_anno$cohort))
col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("Favorable","Medium","Poor"))

ca <- columnAnnotation(
  archetypes = c_anno$survival_ecotypes,
  seq_cohort = c_anno$cohort,
                   col = list(seq_cohort = cohort_col,
                              archetypes = col_group),
                   border = TRUE
                   )

## Step 3: Row Annotation 
r_anno <- data.frame(genes = rownames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
r_anno$key_genes <- ifelse(r_anno$genes %in% c("VHL","PBRM1","BAP1","SETD2"), "key_driver", "other_driver")

## Step 4: Print Oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(mut_list_full,
                  alter_fun = fun_alter,
                  row_split = r_anno$key_genes,
                  col = col, 
                  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE, 
                  pct_side = "right", row_names_side = "left")%v% ca
  

draw(ht_all)
```

## 4B

```{r}
# Mutation encoding 
## Only clonal 
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))
sum_matrix[mut_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5
mut_per_PID <- as.data.frame(t(sum_matrix)) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")
mut_per_PID <- as.data.frame(mut_per_PID)
mut_per_PID_clonal <- mut_per_PID
mut_per_PID_clonal[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] <- ifelse(mut_per_PID_clonal[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] >= 1, 1,0)
colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] <- paste0(colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)], "_clonal")
GOI_clonal <- colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal %>% select(-PID))
for (entry in GOI_clonal) {
  metadata_mutation[,entry] <- mut_per_PID_clonal[,entry][match(metadata_mutation[,"PID"],mut_per_PID_clonal[,"PID"])]
}
GOI_clonal <- GOI_clonal[!GOI_clonal %in% c("SF3B1_clonal","STAG2_clonal","ARHGAP35_clonal")]

# Patient group infos 
cur_groups <- metadata_mutation %>% select(PID, Favorable, Medium, Poor) %>% unique()
cur_mut_clonal <- metadata_mutation %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, GOI_clonal) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test 
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("Favorable", "Medium","Poor"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_clonal, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  return(fisher_results)
  }
isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")

# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

fisher_full$odds_ratio[fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf] <- max(fisher_full$odds_ratio[!fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf])

# Arrange rows/columns
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = c("Poor", "Medium", "Favorable"))
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))

# Filter
mut_selected <- fisher_full %>% filter(result != "NOTSIG") %>% pull(gene) %>% unfactor
fisher_full_selected <- fisher_full %>% filter(gene %in% mut_selected)

# Plot
ggplot(fisher_full_selected, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full_selected,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  coord_flip()
```

## 4C

```{r}
# ONCOPRINT
cnv <- CNV_anno %>% filter(type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss", "gain_neutral", "gain"))
cnv$type_final <- ifelse(cnv$type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss"), "loss", "gain")
cnv <- cnv %>% filter(PID %in% metadata_selected$PID)
cnv$mut_level <- cnv$type_final
cnv <- cnv %>% select(PID, chr_arm, mut_level)
mut_levels_for_matrix <- cnv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select chromosome arms 
chr_arm_list <- cnv %>% pull(chr_arm) %>% unique()

# Main function
CNV_list <- list()
placeholder_chr_arm <- chr_arm_list[1]
pids <- unique(cnv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]
for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  x <- cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  chr_arm %in% chr_arm_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", chr_arm_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), chr_arm) |       
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", chr_arm_list, "$"), collapse="|"), chr_arm) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, chr_arm) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(chr_arm, value)
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_chr_arm
  }
  
  CNV_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}
CNV_list_full <- unify_mat_list(CNV_list)
for (i in seq_along(CNV_list_full)){
  dif_gen = setdiff(chr_arm_list,rownames(CNV_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(CNV_list_full[[i]]))
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(CNV_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(CNV_list_full[[i]])
  CNV_list_full[[i]]=cbind(CNV_list_full[[i]],blank)
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(CNV_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(CNV_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  CNV_list_full[[i]]=rbind(CNV_list_full[[i]],blank)
}

# Clonality anno
subclonal_anno <- CNV_anno %>% filter(type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss", "gain_neutral", "gain")) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = chr_arm, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(CNV_list_full$loss), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(CNV_list_full$loss), colnames(subclonal_anno))]
CNV_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno

## Step 1: Define alteration function
col <- c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8")
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  gain = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#E41A1C", col = NA)),
  loss = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = NA)),
  subclonal = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)
names(col) <- c("gain", "loss") 

## Step 2: Column Annotation
c_anno <- data.frame(PID = colnames(CNV_list_full[1]$loss))
c_anno$cohort <- "old"
c_anno$survival_ecotype <- metadata_selected$survival_ecotype[match(c_anno$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
cohort_col <- setNames("#1F78B4","old")
col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("Favorable","Medium","Poor"))
ca <- columnAnnotation(
  archetypes = c_anno$survival_ecotype,
  seq_cohort = c_anno$cohort,
  col = list(seq_cohort = cohort_col,
             archetypes = col_group),
  border = TRUE
  )

## Step 4: Print Oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(CNV_list_full,
                  alter_fun = fun_alter,
                  col = col, 
                  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE, 
                  pct_side = "right", row_names_side = "left")%v%ca
  
draw(ht_all)
```

```{r}
# CNV encoding 
## Only clonal 
CNV_per_PID <- CNV_anno %>%
  mutate(
    binary = case_when(
      clonality == "clonal" & type_summarized %in% c("gain","loss") ~ 1,
      clonality == "clonal" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = chr_arm_type, values_from = binary)
CNV_per_PID[is.na(CNV_per_PID)] <- 0
CNV_per_PID <- as.data.frame(CNV_per_PID)

  }

fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")

# FDR at 0.1 with trends

fisher_full$odds_ratio[fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf] <- max(fisher_full$odds_ratio[!fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf])

## Arrange rows/columns
```

```{r}
metadata_mutation$genomic_subtype <- genomic_sub$genomic_subtype[match(metadata_mutation$PID, genomic_sub$PID)]

metadata_mutation$BAP1_driven <- ifelse(metadata_mutation$genomic_subtype == "BAP1_driven", "1", "0")

cur_mut_clonal <- metadata_mutation %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, VHL_wildtype, VHL_monodriver, BAP1_driven, PBRM1_driven, multiple_drivers) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()
```

```{r}
## Test association of mutations with survival 
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))
sum_matrix[mut_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5

# Only clonal
mut_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(ifelse(sum_matrix == 1, TRUE, FALSE))) %>% rownames_to_column("PID") 
mut_matrix$status_OS <- metadata_selected$status_OS[match(mut_matrix$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
mut_matrix$OS_months <- metadata_selected$OS_months[match(mut_matrix$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]

# KAPLAN-MEIER ESTIMATE 
# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(mut_matrix %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  mut_matrix[[x]] <- factor(mut_matrix[[x]], levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = mut_matrix)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)
cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN_trend",NA))))
cur_surv_plot$type <- "mutation"

ggplot(cur_surv_plot, aes(x=reorder(group,ratio), y = type, col = ratio, size= -log10(p)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = cur_surv_plot, shape = 1, aes(size = -log10(p), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
```

## S6C 

```{r}
# Create list from results
cv_results_list <- list(
  "MUT" = BF_MUT_MUT,
  "IMC" = BF_MUT_IMC,
  "IMC_MUT" = BF_MUT_IMC_MUT
)

# Define colors 
col_cv <- setNames(c("grey","firebrick1", "#22b2b2"),
c("MUT", "IMC", "IMC_MUT"))

# INTEGRATED BRIER SCORE
# Initialize list to store IBS scores for each cross-validation result
ibs_scores_list <- list()
ibs_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    if (nrow(res$actual_surv) != nrow(res$actual_test)) {
      stop("Row count mismatch between actual_surv and actual_test")
    }
    test_data <- cbind(res$actual_surv, res$actual_test)
    times_test <- sort(unique(test_data$OS_months))
    if(!0 %in% times_test){
    times_test <- c(0, times_test) 
    }
    times_pred <- res$predictions$unique.death.times
    time_indices <- sapply(times_test, function(t) which.min(abs(times_pred - t)))
    aligned_surv_probs <- res$predictions$survival[, time_indices, drop = FALSE]
    pec_obj <- pec(
      object = list("BlockForest" = aligned_surv_probs),
      formula = Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ 1,
      cens.model = "marginal",
      exact = TRUE,
      data = test_data
    )
    IBSrange <- quantile(test_data$OS_months, 0.9)
    crps_val <- crps(pec_obj, start = 0, times = IBSrange)
    ibs_score <- crps_val[2] 
    return(ibs_score)
  })
})
out_ibs <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", ibs_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "IBS")

# Plot
ggplot(out_ibs, aes(x = reorder(model,-IBS, FUN = mean), y = IBS, fill = model))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "MUT", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "less", label = "p.format"))+
  stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Integrated Brier Score")

# CONCORDANCE
# Initialize list to store concordance scores for each cross-validation result
concordance_scores_list <- list()
concordance_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    out <- concordance(Surv(res$actual_surv[, 1], res$actual_surv[, 2]) ~ rowSums(res$predictions$survival), timewt = "n/G2")
    return(out$concordance)
  })
})
out_concordance <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", concordance_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "concordance")

# Plot
ggplot(out_concordance, aes(x = reorder(model,concordance, FUN = median), y = concordance, fill = model))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "MUT", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "greater", label = "p.format"))+
  stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Concordance (Uno)")
```

## S6F 

```{r}
celltype_density$celltype_combined_immune <- ifelse(celltype_density$celltype_combined_broad %in% c("B_cell", "CD4_T_cell", "CD8_T_cell", "Macrophage", 
"Neutrophil", "Plasma_cell"), "Immune", celltype_density$celltype_combined_broad)
celltype_density <- celltype_density %>% filter(!celltype_combined_broad %in% c("Unknown_Other"))

# Add ecotype and PBRM1 mutation
celltype_density$survival_ecotype <- metadata_mutation$survival_ecotype[match(celltype_density$PID, metadata_mutation$PID)]
celltype_density$PBRM1_mut <- as.character(metadata_mutation$PBRM1_clonal[match(celltype_density$PID, metadata_mutation$PID)])
celltype_density_medium_PBRM1 <- celltype_density %>% filter(!is.na(PBRM1_mut) & survival_ecotype == "Medium")
general_count_out <- celltype_density_medium_PBRM1 %>% group_by(PID, celltype_combined_immune) %>% summarise(Freq = round(mean(Freq), digits = 0))
general_count_wide <- general_count_out %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = celltype_combined_immune, values_from = Freq) %>% ungroup() %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% t()

### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
DA <- lapply(c("PBRM1_mut"), function(x){
abundances <- general_count_wide
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
meta <- celltype_density_medium_PBRM1[match(colnames(abundances), celltype_density_medium_PBRM1$PID),] %>% as.data.frame
meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))
DA <- res$table
DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table
DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$PValue<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$PValue < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$PValue < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))
DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x
return(DA)
})
DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)

# Plot
ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(PValue)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(PValue), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
## Test association of mutations with survival 
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, CNV_list_full)
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))
sum_matrix[CNV_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5

# Only clonal
mut_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(ifelse(sum_matrix == 1, TRUE, FALSE))) %>% rownames_to_column("PID") 
mut_matrix$status_OS <- metadata_selected$status_OS[match(mut_matrix$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
mut_matrix$OS_months <- metadata_selected$OS_months[match(mut_matrix$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]

# KAPLAN-MEIER ESTIMATE 
# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(mut_matrix %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  mut_matrix[[x]] <- factor(mut_matrix[[x]], levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = mut_matrix)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)
cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN_trend",NA))))
cur_surv_plot$type <- "mutation"

ggplot(cur_surv_plot, aes(x=reorder(group,ratio), y = type, col = ratio, size= -log10(p)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = cur_surv_plot, shape = 1, aes(size = -log10(p), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
```

## S6J 

```{r}
# Update for association testing
metadata_CNV$pT_combined[metadata_CNV$pT_combined == "T1/2"] <- "0"
metadata_CNV$pT_combined[metadata_CNV$pT_combined == "T3/4"] <- "1"
metadata_CNV$ISUP_combined[metadata_CNV$ISUP_combined == "G1/2"] <- "0"
metadata_CNV$ISUP_combined[metadata_CNV$ISUP_combined == "G3/4"] <- "1"
metadata_CNV$necrose[metadata_CNV$necrose == "NE0"] <- "0"
metadata_CNV$necrose[metadata_CNV$necrose == "NE1"] <- "1"
metadata_CNV$PDL1_score[metadata_CNV$PDL1_score == "PD0"] <- "0"
metadata_CNV$PDL1_score[metadata_CNV$PDL1_score == "PD1"] <- "1"

# Patient group infos
cur_groups <- metadata_CNV %>% select(PID,all_of(CNV_clonal)) %>% unique()
cur_test <- metadata_CNV %>% select(PID, pT_combined, ISUP_combined, necrose, PDL1_score) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% t()
cur_groups <- cur_groups[cur_groups$PID %in% colnames(cur_test),]
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = CNV_clonal, .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_test, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")

# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

fisher_full$odds_ratio[fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf] <- max(fisher_full$odds_ratio[!fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf])

## Arrange rows/columns
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))

# Filter
mut_selected <- fisher_full %>% filter(result != "NOTSIG") %>% pull(category) %>% unfactor %>% unique()
fisher_full_selected <- fisher_full %>% filter(category %in% mut_selected)

ggplot(fisher_full_selected, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full_selected,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}
# Create list from results
cv_results_list <- list(
  "CNV" = BF_CNV_CNV,
  "IMC" = BF_CNV_IMC,
  "IMC_CNV" = BF_CNV_IMC_CNV
)

# Define colors 
col_cv <- setNames(c("grey","firebrick1", "#b2b222"),
c("CNV", "IMC", "IMC_CNV"))

# INTEGRATED BRIER SCORE
# Initialize list to store IBS scores for each cross-validation result
ibs_scores_list <- list()
ibs_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    if (nrow(res$actual_surv) != nrow(res$actual_test)) {
      stop("Row count mismatch between actual_surv and actual_test")
    }
    test_data <- cbind(res$actual_surv, res$actual_test)
    times_test <- sort(unique(test_data$OS_months))
    if(!0 %in% times_test){
    times_test <- c(0, times_test)
    }
    times_pred <- res$predictions$unique.death.times
    time_indices <- sapply(times_test, function(t) which.min(abs(times_pred - t)))
    aligned_surv_probs <- res$predictions$survival[, time_indices, drop = FALSE]
    pec_obj <- pec(
      object = list("BlockForest" = aligned_surv_probs),
      formula = Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ 1,
      cens.model = "marginal",
      exact = TRUE,
      data = test_data
    )
    IBSrange <- quantile(test_data$OS_months, 0.9)
    crps_val <- crps(pec_obj, start = 0, times = IBSrange)
    ibs_score <- crps_val[2] 
    return(ibs_score)
  })
})
out_ibs <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", ibs_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "IBS")

# Plot
ggplot(out_ibs, aes(x = reorder(model,-IBS, FUN = median), y = IBS, fill = model))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "CNV", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "less", label = "p.format"))+
  stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Integrated Brier Score")

# CONCORDANCE
# Initialize list to store concordance scores for each cross-validation result
concordance_scores_list <- list()
concordance_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    out <- concordance(Surv(res$actual_surv[, 1], res$actual_surv[, 2]) ~ rowSums(res$predictions$survival), timewt = "n/G2")
    return(out$concordance)
  })
})

out_concordance <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", concordance_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "concordance")

# Plot
ggplot(out_concordance, aes(x = model, y = concordance, fill = model))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "CNV", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "greater", label = "p.format"))+
  stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Concordance (Uno)")
```

## S7B 

```{r}
# DISEASE PROGRESSION
progression_p_test <- function(SE, x, group) {
  SE_sub <- SE[,!is.na(SE[[group]])]
  mean_SE <- aggregateAcrossCells(SE_sub,
                                  ids = SE_sub[[group]],
                                  statistics = "mean",
                                  use.assay.type = "min_max")
  logFC <- log2(assay(mean_SE, "min_max")[, mean_SE[[group]] == x] /
                assay(mean_SE, "min_max")[, mean_SE[[group]] != x])
  min_max <- as.data.frame(t(assay(SE_sub, "min_max")))
  min_max[[group]] <- SE_sub[[group]]
  p_value <- c()
  t_score <- c()
  for (i in 1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)) {
    t <- wilcox.test(min_max[min_max[[group]] == x, i], 
                min_max[min_max[[group]] != x, i])
    p_value[i] <- t$p.value
  }
  names(p_value) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  p_value_adj <- p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  names(p_value_adj) <- colnames(min_max)[1:(ncol(min_max) - 1)]
  data <- as.data.frame(cbind(logFC, p_value_adj))
  data$category <- group
  data <- data %>% rownames_to_column("mass")
  return(data)
}

out_ISUP <- progression_p_test(metabolites_SE, "G3/4", "ISUP_combined")
out_pT <- progression_p_test(metabolites_SE, "T3/4", "pT_combined")
out_necrose <- progression_p_test(metabolites_SE, "NE1", "necrose")
out_PDL1 <- progression_p_test(metabolites_SE, "1", "PDL1_score")
out_all <- rbind(out_ISUP, out_pT, out_necrose, out_PDL1)
out_all$direction <- ifelse(out_all$logFC >= 0, "high", "low")

# Filter
mass_sig <- out_all %>% filter(p_value_adj < 0.05) %>% group_by(mass, direction) %>% dplyr::count() %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% dplyr::filter(n > 2) %>% pull(mass)
out_all_sig <- out_all %>% filter(mass %in% mass_sig) 
out_all_sig$result <- ifelse(out_all_sig$direction == "high" & out_all_sig$p_value_adj < 0.05, "UP",
                                    ifelse(out_all_sig$direction == "low" & out_all_sig$p_value_adj < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))
out_all_sig$type <- "metabo"

# Plot
ggplot(out_all_sig, aes(x=reorder(mass,logFC), y = category, col = logFC, size= -log10(p_value_adj )))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 0)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = out_all_sig, shape = 1, aes(size = -log10(p_value_adj ), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}
# Create list from results
cv_results_list <- list(
  "META" = BF_META_META,
  "IMC" = BF_META_IMC,
  "IMC_META" = BF_META_IMC_META
)

# Define colors 
col_cv <- setNames(c("grey","firebrick1", "#b26a22"),
c("META", "IMC", "IMC_META"))

# INTEGRATED BRIER SCORE
# Initialize list to store IBS scores for each cross-validation result
ibs_scores_list <- list()
ibs_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    if (nrow(res$actual_surv) != nrow(res$actual_test)) {
      stop("Row count mismatch between actual_surv and actual_test")
    }
    test_data <- cbind(res$actual_surv, res$actual_test)
    times_test <- sort(unique(test_data$OS_months))
    if(!0 %in% times_test){
    times_test <- c(0, times_test) 
    }
    times_pred <- res$predictions$unique.death.times
    time_indices <- sapply(times_test, function(t) which.min(abs(times_pred - t)))
    aligned_surv_probs <- res$predictions$survival[, time_indices, drop = FALSE]
    pec_obj <- pec(
      object = list("BlockForest" = aligned_surv_probs),
      formula = Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ 1,
      cens.model = "marginal",
      exact = TRUE,
      data = test_data
    )
    IBSrange <- quantile(test_data$OS_months, 0.9)
    crps_val <- crps(pec_obj, start = 0, times = IBSrange)
    ibs_score <- crps_val[2] 
    
    return(ibs_score)
  })
})
out_ibs <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", ibs_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "IBS")

# Plot
ggplot(out_ibs, aes(x = reorder(model,-IBS, FUN = median), y = IBS, fill = model))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "META", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "less", label = "p.format"))+
  stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Integrated Brier Score")

# CONCORDANCE
# Initialize list to store concordance scores for each cross-validation result
concordance_scores_list <- list()
concordance_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    out <- concordance(Surv(res$actual_surv[, 1], res$actual_surv[, 2]) ~ rowSums(res$predictions$survival), timewt = "n/G2")
    return(out$concordance)
  })
})

out_concordance <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", concordance_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "concordance")

# Plot
ggplot(out_concordance, aes(x = reorder(model,concordance, FUN = median), y = concordance, fill = model))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "META", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "greater", label = "p.format"))+
  stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Concordance (Uno)")
```

```{r}
  node_shape_by = "celltype_combined_broad", 
  colPairName = "neighborhood", 
  coords = c("Pos_X", "Pos_Y"),
  draw_edges = TRUE, 
  nodes_first = FALSE, 
  directed = FALSE, 
  ncols = 1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#004080", "#636BFF", "#B2226A"))
```

## S8E

```{r}
# Update for association testing
metadata_T$pT_combined[metadata_T$pT_combined == "T1/2"] <- "0"
metadata_T$pT_combined[metadata_T$pT_combined == "T3/4"] <- "1"
metadata_T$ISUP_combined[metadata_T$ISUP_combined == "G1/2"] <- "0"
metadata_T$ISUP_combined[metadata_T$ISUP_combined == "G3/4"] <- "1"
metadata_T$necrose[metadata_T$necrose == "NE0"] <- "0"
metadata_T$necrose[metadata_T$necrose == "NE1"] <- "1"
metadata_T$PDL1_score[metadata_T$PDL1_score == "PD0"] <- "0"
metadata_T$PDL1_score[metadata_T$PDL1_score == "PD1"] <- "1"

# Patient group info 
encoded <- as.data.frame(predict(dummyVars(~ spatial_CD8_group, data = metadata_T, fullRank = FALSE), newdata = metadata_T))
colnames(encoded) <- str_split(colnames(encoded), "spatial_CD8_group", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
metadata_T <- cbind(metadata_T, encoded)
cur_groups <- metadata_T %>% select(PID,inflamed,excluded,cold) %>% unique()
cur_test <- metadata_T %>% select(PID, pT_combined, ISUP_combined, necrose, PDL1_score) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% t()
cur_groups <- cur_groups[cur_groups$PID %in% colnames(cur_test),]

fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("inflamed", "excluded","cold"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_test, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")

# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "UP",
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "DOWN","NOTSIG"))

## Arrange rows/columns
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df$category)
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score"))

# Plot
ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  coord_flip()
```

## S8F

```{r}
# Compare to number groups
out <- colData(sce_T) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, sample_id, spatial_CD8_pheno, celltype_combined_broad) %>% filter(celltype_combined_broad == "CD8") %>% group_by(sample_id, spatial_CD8_pheno, PID) %>% dplyr::count() %>% group_by(PID, spatial_CD8_pheno) %>% mutate(n = mean(n)) %>% select(PID, spatial_CD8_pheno, n) %>% unique()
out$CD8_category <- ifelse(out$n <= quantile(out$n, probs = seq(0,1,0.33))[2], "low", 
                           ifelse(out$n >= quantile(out$n, probs = seq(0,1,0.33))[3], "high", "medium"))
out_viz <- out %>% group_by(CD8_category, spatial_CD8_pheno) %>% dplyr::count() %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(CD8_category) %>% mutate(fra = n/sum(n))
out_viz$CD8_category <- factor(out_viz$CD8_category, levels = c("high","medium","low"))
sce_T$CD8_number_category <- out$CD8_category[match(sce_T$PID, out$PID)]

# Plot survival curves
cur_surv <- colData(sce_T) %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(PID %in% metadata_selected$PID) %>% select(PID, CD8_number_category, OS_months, status_OS) %>% unique()
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ CD8_number_category, data = cur_surv)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE,
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(),
          palette = "Set1")
```
